# Reneplane - Full Product Documentation

Reneplane provides premium, 100% pure organic powder products sourced from certified organic farms. All our products are USDA certified organic, GMO-free, and filler-free. We proudly ship to the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Philippines, and India.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **How do I use the powder products?** Add 1–2 teaspoons to smoothies, juices, soups, or sprinkle over salads. It blends easily into any recipe.
- **Are these products suitable for vegans?** Yes! All Reneplane powders are 100% plant-based, vegan, and free from any animal-derived ingredients.
- **How long does shipping take?** Standard shipping takes 3–7 business days. Express options are available at checkout.
- **What is the shelf life?** Our powders have a shelf life of 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place with the resealable pouch properly sealed.

## Why Choose Us?
- 100% Pure Ingredients (No stems, fillers, or additives)
- Certified Organic (USDA certified organic and non-GMO verified)
- Nutrient Powerhouse (Rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants)
